# KapanLagi English

> > English-language entertainment news covering Indonesian celebrities, K-dramas, Chinese actors, anime adaptations, and Southeast Asian pop culture.

KapanLagi English delivers celebrity news, film reviews, and entertainment coverage focused on Indonesian stars like Rachel Vennya, Ussy Sulistiawaty, and Fariz RM, alongside international content including Korean dramas, Chinese entertainment, anime live-action adaptations, and Hollywood news. The site also features cultural content around Islamic observances like Ramadan and Eid al-Fitr.
